name: Carter Vanderweyden
source:
The most powerful [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Malkavian_(VTM)]Malkavian[/url] in the city, he holds the position of his Clan's [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Primogen_(VTM)]Primogen[/url] and is biding his time for the opportunity to finally become [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_(VTM)]Prince[/url]. 

The Vanderweydens were one of the original Dutch merchant families to settle in the New York region - it is this legacy that makes Carter believe princedom is his birthright. He thinks of himself as a modern-day Kennedy. 

Masquerading as a lawyer in a well-established family practice, and flourishing with a series of high-profile cases, he is intricately familiar with the workings of New York City elites, human and vampire alike.

[From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook[/url]]
